datasets.name: Golden Gate Park
datasets.title: Golden Gate Park
datasets.description: Point cloud of Golden Gate Park in San Francisco, captured by drone with an Ouster OS1 Max. Fly through it, switch between true color and reflectivity, and zoom down to individual points.

tour.name: Golden Gate Park from above
tour.caption: One drone flight, 1.41 billion points. OS1 Max captures up to 10.4 million points per second across 256 channels, with color from the sensor itself.

tour.name: Through the canopy
tour.caption: 256 channels sweep the canopy from many angles in a single pass, so the cloud holds crowns, the gaps between them, and the ground underneath.

tour.name: Wires, up close
tour.caption: A narrow beam keeps the laser spot small enough to trace a utility pole and the thin wires strung from it, against the building behind.

tour.name: Where the park meets the city
tour.caption: 200 m of range at 10% reflectivity puts forest, streets, and rooftops in the same flight from the same altitude.

tour.name: City blocks in plan
tour.caption: Precision down to ±0.25 cm keeps rooflines and curbs crisp enough to measure. Use Measure to check a roof edge or a street width.

tour.name: The whole capture
tour.caption: End of the tour. Drag to explore, or switch to Reflectivity: signal strength corrected for range, so each surface shows how strongly it returns the laser.

datasets.caption: Golden Gate Park, San Francisco. Drone-captured Ouster OS1 Max point cloud, 1.41 B points.
